description: This Java class 'OrderSummary' models an order summary object used in e-commerce processes, encapsulating shipping information and product items for order calculations.

classes.name: OrderSummary
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a summary of an order, including shipping details and list of shopping cart items.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items for this order summary.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of shopping cart items associated with this order summary.
